description: This file defines the OrdersService class which handles order processing, including placing orders, listing, retrieving, and updating order statuses in an online food ordering platform backend.

classes.name: OrdersService
classes.description: A class providing methods to manage orders such as placing, listing, retrieving, and updating orders in the food delivery platform.

methods.name: placeOrder(userId, { delivery_address = null, delivery_lat = null, delivery_lng = null })
methods.description: Converts the user's active cart into a finalized order, including copying cart items into order items and updating cart status.

methods.name: listOrders(userId, { limit = 50, offset = 0 } = {})
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of orders for a specific user.

methods.name: getOrder(userId, orderId)
methods.description: Fetches detailed information about a specific order belonging to a user, including its items.

methods.name: updateStatus(orderId, { status, payment_status })
methods.description: Allows updating the status and/or payment status of an existing order, typically for administrative or courier purposes.

ctags.name: placeOrder
ctags.pattern: /^  async placeOrder(userId, { delivery_address = null, delivery_lat = null, delivery_lng = null }/
ctags.signature: (userId, { delivery_address = null, delivery_lat = null, delivery_lng = null })
